roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. In this vital dual role, you will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control within our facility. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on both staff competency and resident safety.

As the Staff Development Coordinator, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for our clinical staff, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and promoting professional growth. Concurrently, as the Infection Control Nurse, you will lead our infection prevention efforts, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff on best practices to maintain a safe and healthy environment for our residents and team members. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland
Proven experience as a Staff Development Coordinator or in a similar education role
Demonstrated experience in Infection Prevention and Control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations, including CMS and CDC guidelines
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a recently acquired skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential opportunity for a proactive and results-driven professional to make a significant impact on our facility's growth and community presence. The ideal candidate will be a 'hustler' with a passion for healthcare marketing and a commitment to excellence.This role requires a presentable individual who is comfortable working occasional weekends to meet the demands of our vibrant community. We are looking for a leader who can develop and execute innovative marketing strategies to enhance our reputation and drive census growth. For the right person, this position offers a highly competitive compensation package and the chance to be part of a forward-thinking team dedicated to providing exceptional care.
requirements: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Marketing Director, ideally within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated success in developing and implementing effective marketing strategies to increase facility census.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a professional and presentable demeanor.
Ability to work occasional weekends and adapt to the dynamic needs of the role.
A proactive, results-oriented mindset with a strong drive to achieve goals.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive compensation for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential speech and language services to patients, contributing significantly to their recovery and quality of life. We are looking for a compassionate professional ready to make an immediate impact.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate and a generous sign-on or relocation bonus. If you are a skilled SLP looking for a flexible PRN opportunity with a supportive team, we encourage you to apply today and become a vital part of our patient-centered care.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Physical Therapist (PT) for a PRN opportunity at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility of a PRN schedule, allowing you to provide essential therapy services while maintaining work-life balance. You will play a crucial role in helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life.

As a PRN Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing patient needs, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing therapeutic interventions. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a supportive team environment focused on patient-centered care and positive outcomes. Join us in making a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting preferred
Ability to work a flexible, PRN schedule
Strong clinical assessment, treatment, and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate for Physical Therapists ranging from $39.00 to $40.00 per hour.

roleTitle: Therapist (OT, PT, ST) / Therapy Assistant (COTA, PTA)
description:
We are seeking dedicated and skilled Occupational Therapists (OT), Physical Therapists (PT), Speech Therapists (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment, helping patients achieve their rehabilitation goals and improve their quality of life.

Both full-time and part-time positions are available, offering competitive compensation based on your role and experience. Join a team committed to excellence in patient care and professional growth.
requirements: Valid Florida license/certification as an OT, PT, ST, COTA, or PTA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
salaryOrBonusInfo: COTA/PTA roles offer $28.00 - $37.00/hr, while OT/PT/ST roles offer $40.00 - $46.00/hr.
